task.title: M5: Compare view shows one panel at a time (Treemap | Edges | Changes)
task.description:
The compare page is too busy with the delta treemap, the changed-edges graph, and the biggest-changes table all on screen at once. Keep the summary line and the base/head toolbar always visible, and put the three panels behind a segmented control inside the compare view so only one shows at a time: Treemap (delta treemap with its Changed-only toggle and legend), Edges (the changed-edges graph with its All/Added/Removed filter), and Changes (the biggest-changes table). The selection is remembered in the URL hash as panel=treemap|edges|changes (default treemap) alongside view, base, and head. The active panel takes the full main area height.

Acceptance criteria:
- Only one of the three panels is in the DOM-visible layout at a time; the other two are hidden, not destroyed, so switching back is instant and keeps state (table sort, edge filter, treemap zoom).
- The segmented control sits directly under the base/head toolbar and reflects the hash on first load; changing it updates the hash without reloading the comparison.
- Clicking a table row in Changes switches to the Treemap panel and highlights that file.
- Resizing while a hidden panel is active does not break its layout when it is shown again (the treemap and graph re-fit on show).
- The headless Chrome smoke run covers switching panels and the row-click handoff with no console errors.
